original_prompt: Create a brand NEW photorealistic full-length studio photograph of the adult man in the attached PORTRAIT, using it only to preserve facial identity, hair and upper clothing. Reconstruct a balanced complete body from scratch. Short dense swept dark hair, gray-green eyes, pronounced straight brows and defined square jaw, clean shaven; dark charcoal tweed suit and waistcoat, taupe shirt, espresso tie and small silver tie bar. Lower clothing: matching charcoal tweed trousers, dark brown leather Oxford shoes. Anatomically balanced real adult male, approximately 7.5 heads tall, healthy lean build, ordinary naturally tall proportions. Normal sized head, normal neck, complete ribcage and pelvis, moderate waist, proportional arms and hands. CRITICAL: crotch-to-floor inseam around 46-47% of total crown-to-floor height, crown-to-crotch around 53-54%; thighs and shins of believable length, neither segment stretched. Waistband at ordinary natural waist, below navel, not extreme high-rise. No supermodel elongated legs, tiny torso, shrunken head, compressed abdomen or long neck. Not squat either. Anatomical landmarks must work together, not just extend the torso to compensate. Front-facing neutral relaxed standing pose, arms naturally down, fingertips about mid-thigh. Preserve distinctive face and clothing, accurate seams, sleeves, accessories. Usual garment lengths, straight trouser legs with modest realistic drape. White seamless background with delicate floor contact shadows. Camera level at mid-body, 85mm equivalent from sufficient distance, vertical lines parallel, no low-angle perspective. Sharp natural pores, individual hair and fabric texture, premium real photography, not CGI. Full hair to soles visible with comfortable small margins. Portrait 2:3. No text, no watermark, no measurement guides. Goal is a believable handsome real man with harmonious head/torso/leg balance, not exaggerated runway proportions.
